# Marvel

> Marvel is a comprehensive design platform enabling teams to prototype, design, test, and handoff digital products collaboratively.

Marvel provides an all-in-one solution for product designers and teams, integrating prototyping, wireframing, design tools, user testing, and developer handoff capabilities. The platform supports seamless workflows across iOS, Android, and web applications with integrations into popular design tools like Sketch.

## Key Topics

- Prototyping
- Design Collaboration
- User Testing
- Design Handoff
- Wireframing
- Sketch Integration
- Mobile Design
- Design-to-Development
- Team Collaboration
- Design Specs
- Interactive Prototypes
- CSS/Swift/Android Code Generation
- Enterprise Design
- Digital Products

## Core Features

- [Prototyping](https://marvelapp.com/features/prototyping): Turn sketches into realistic interactive prototypes for websites and mobile apps.
- [Design](https://marvelapp.com/features/design): Browser-based design tool for creating mockups and digital designs.
- [Wireframing](https://marvelapp.com/features/wireframing): Rapid wireframe tool with templates and assets for iOS, Android, and desktop design.
- [User Testing](https://marvelapp.com/user-testing): Validate designs and collect user feedback through integrated testing capabilities.
- [Design Handoff](https://marvelapp.com/features/handoff): Generate developer-ready specs for CSS, Swift, and Android from your designs.
- [Collaboration](https://marvelapp.com/features/collaboration): Enable team feedback and design annotations for streamlined collaboration.

## Integrations & Plugins

- [Integrations](https://marvelapp.com/features/integrations): Connect with Sketch, Jira, Dropbox Paper, and other design and development tools.
- [Sketch Plugin](https://marvelapp.com/sketch): Seamlessly sync Sketch artboards and hotspots into Marvel for prototyping.

## Plans & Deployment

- [Pricing](https://marvelapp.com/pricing): Flexible pricing plans for individuals, teams, and enterprises.
- [Enterprise](https://marvelapp.com/enterprise): Scalable platform for large teams with advanced security and integrations.
- [Mobile Apps](https://marvelapp.com/apps): Marvel apps for iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch, and Android devices.
